Definition: from G1537 and a derivative of G1325; given out or over, i.e. surrendered:--delivered.
BiblicalUsage: This word means given out or over, surrendered, and Peter uses it once, in his sermon at Pentecost. Jesus, being delivered by the determinate counsel and foreknowledge of God, was taken by wicked hands and crucified and slain. The word holds both truths at once: God gave Him up, and men took Him.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the cross was both God's plan and man's crime, because Peter says God delivered Him and wicked hands slew Him, and both are true.
